theme: A quiet day in Cavtat before the long flight home.
greeting: The charter is done and you're ashore at the Remisens in Cavtat, Dan — today's the calm before a long travel day. The work worth doing from dry land is locking tomorrow's pre-dawn exit and the Florida landing.

needsAttention.title: Lock tomorrow's 5:15 AM Cavtat exit
needsAttention.detail: You leave ~5:15 AM Sunday for LH4297 at 7:30. Confirm express/night checkout with the hotel and book the airport taxi today — not from the counter at dawn.

needsAttention.title: Book the TPA rental car outright
needsAttention.detail: Full-Size SUV at Tampa, Sept 20–Oct 5, to carry all six. You land Sunday at 3:55 PM — don't arrive jet-lagged to walk-up Sunday rates with no car.

needsAttention.title: Book St Pete for the Sept 20–22 gap
needsAttention.detail: You land Sunday but the kids aren't picked up until Tuesday 3 PM and the Orlando villa starts that evening. Two nights (20th, 21st) in St Pete are still unbooked.

flagged.title: New VP, Government Affairs roles
flagged.detail: LinkedIn flagged openings similar to the Macy's VP, Government Affairs post — worth a scan when you land.

flagged.title: Venmo request — lawn mowing
flagged.detail: Joshua Weaver requested $50 for mowing on 9/17.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and receipts — NYT Cooking, Ridgeline, market briefs, an Uber receipt, subscription renewals.

recipe.title: Vin santo-roasted pears
recipe.why: Pears hit their autumn stride now, and a slow roast in sweet wine concentrates them.

tasks.title: Book Maine Christmas SUV rental (refundable, PWM)
Confirm St Pete Airbnb (Sep 27–Oct 5) converted from pending
Buy Disney park tickets for the six of you (Sep 26–27)

acts.line: Off the boat at Komolac and down to Cavtat — the sailing week is behind you.
An all-inclusive rest day at the Remisens with nothing on the calendar.
An early night ahead of a 5:15 AM checkout — pack and confirm the taxi tonight.
